description.zh: 400 個實用核心字，配例句、搭配同精選日常用法。需要先識基本文法及組句字，再配合情境對答練習；唔代表涵蓋 95% 對話或保證流利。

level.zh: 已有基本組句能力，進一步練日常口語（非 CEFR 認證）

exampleSources: Existing project simple-english-1000-complete.json and simple-english-2000.json entries, screened and corrected for this list.
Original source detailed senses retained with targeted corrections; new examples and definitions authored for gaps.
editorialNotes.translationStyle: Traditional Chinese for Hong Kong readers; existing clear written-Chinese translations retained, new conversational examples use Cantonese.
editorialNotes.synonymPolicy: Only selected alternatives for a taught sense; not interchangeable in every context. Empty arrays are valid; categories and definitions are not synonyms.
editorialNotes.originalSnapshot: artifacts/spoken-core-400/original.json (local audit snapshot; not required for regeneration)
editorialNotes.sourceOfTruth: This file. Each use.examples array is the source of truth; the top-level examples and import JSON must include all of them. Every taught sense needs at least two distinct examples.

usageReferences.purpose: Checked be about to and common about constructions; examples are project-authored.
Checked core get constructions; examples are original project teaching content.

prerequisites.noteZhHant: 呢 400 字係核心內容字，唔係由零開始嘅完整字表。以下係開始前要識或同步補學嘅基礎組句字；唔計入 400。例句亦可能有其他情境字，遇到唔識要另外學。

example.en: I can help you with your bag.
This is a bag. The bag is mine.
Could you help me? I cannot open this.
example.zhHant: 可唔可以幫下我？我打唔開呢個。

example.en: No, I do not need it.
I want to go, but I am busy.
Meet me at the station at six.
How much time do we have?
Sorry, could you say that again, please?
example.zhHant: 唔好意思，可唔可以再講一次？

example.en: I like tea. She is tired.

grammar.pattern: Do/Does + subject + base verb? / subject + do/does not + base verb

example.en: Does he work here? He does not work here.
example.zhHant: 佢係咪喺度返工？佢唔係喺度返工。

grammar.pattern: subject + past form / did not + base verb

example.en: I went home early. I did not stay.
example.zhHant: 我早咗返屋企。我冇留低。

example.en: We are waiting for the bus.

grammar.pattern: will + base verb / be going to + base verb

example.en: I will call you. We are going to cook tonight.
example.zhHant: 我會打俾你。我哋今晚打算煮飯。

example.en: I have already eaten. Have you been there?
example.zhHant: 我已經食咗嘢。你去過嗰度未？

grammar.pattern: a book / two books; some water / much water

example.en: I need two books and some water.
This bag is cheaper than that one.

contractions.full: it is / it has (depends on the sentence)
I would / I had (depends on the sentence)

readinessCheckZhHant: 唔睇答案講一句自我介紹。
講一句否定句同一句昨日發生嘅事。
用 Sorry, could you say that again? 請人重複。

speakingPractice.noteZhHant: 以下係教材練習，未加入網站自動口語評分。先睇示範，再遮住答案同朋友／老師輪流扮演；亦可自己錄音重聽。唔識嘅額外字先查清楚。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: What is your name?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: My name is Sam. I live in this city.
dialogue.zhHant: 我叫 Sam。我住喺呢個城市。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: What do you do?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I work in a shop. I like meeting people.
dialogue.zhHant: 我喺舖頭返工。我鍾意識唔同嘅人。

scenarios.taskZhHant: 用自己嘅資料講住邊、做咩、鍾意做咩。
scenarios.followUpQuestion: What do you like about your job?
scenarios.noteZhHant: What do you do? 喺呢段對話係問工作，唔係問你而家做緊乜。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Are you ready to order?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Yes, I would like a coffee and some water, please.
dialogue.zhHant: 係，我想要杯咖啡同啲水，唔該。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Would you like milk with your coffee?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: No, thanks. Just black coffee, please.

scenarios.taskZhHant: 落一個餐飲訂單，再講一項唔要／想改嘅材料。
scenarios.followUpQuestion: Would you like anything to eat?
scenarios.noteZhHant: I would like 比 I want 更適合禮貌落單。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Excuse me, how do I get to the station?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Walk down this street and turn left.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Is it far from here?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: No, it is about five minutes away.

scenarios.taskZhHant: 問一個地方點去，聽完再用自己說話確認方向。
scenarios.followUpQuestion: Would you rather walk or take the bus?
scenarios.noteZhHant: 唔識方向時問清楚；唔好只答 yes。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: What is the price of this bag?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: It is fifty dollars.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Do you have a cheaper one?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Yes, this small one is twenty dollars.

scenarios.taskZhHant: 問價、比較兩件貨品，再問付款方法。
scenarios.followUpQuestion: Would you like to pay by card?
scenarios.noteZhHant: 數字、貨幣同尺寸要另外練熟，唔包含喺 400 詞頭入面。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Are you free tomorrow evening?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Yes. Shall we meet at six?
dialogue.zhHant: 得閒。我哋六點見，好唔好？

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Can we meet a little later?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Sure. Seven is fine with me.

scenarios.taskZhHant: 約人見面，再改一次時間，最後確認地點。
scenarios.followUpQuestion: Where would you like to meet?
scenarios.noteZhHant: 用完整時間確認，避免只講 later。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Can you help me with this?
dialogue.zhHant: 你可唔可以幫我睇下呢個？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Of course. What is the problem?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: I do not understand this part. Could you explain it?
dialogue.zhHant: 我唔明呢部分。你可唔可以解釋下？

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Sure. Let us check it together.

scenarios.taskZhHant: 指出一個工作問題、請人幫手、再重述你明白咗嘅做法。
scenarios.followUpQuestion: When do you need to finish it?
scenarios.noteZhHant: explain it to me，唔係 explain me it。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: How do you feel today?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I feel tired. I did not sleep well.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Are you worried about something?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Yes, I have a lot of work to finish.
dialogue.zhHant: 係，我仲有好多工作要做完。

scenarios.taskZhHant: 講一個感受、原因，同你打算做嘅事。
scenarios.followUpQuestion: What would help you feel better?
scenarios.noteZhHant: feel + adjective；better 係 good/well 嘅比較級，要連變化一齊學。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Please meet me at the office at nine.
dialogue.zhHant: 請九點喺辦公室同我見面。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Sorry, could you say that again more slowly?
dialogue.zhHant: 唔好意思，可唔可以講慢啲，再講一次？

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: At the office. At nine in the morning.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Okay, nine in the morning. Thank you.

scenarios.taskZhHant: 請對方重複、講慢啲，再用自己說話確認內容。
scenarios.noteZhHant: 重述關鍵資料，可以確認自己有冇聽錯。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: What did you do yesterday?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I visited a friend and we cooked dinner together.
dialogue.zhHant: 我探咗個朋友，我哋一齊煮晚飯。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Did you enjoy it?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Yes, we had a great time.

scenarios.taskZhHant: 用三句說話講返一件已發生嘅事：時間、做咗乜、感受。
scenarios.followUpQuestion: Would you like to do that again?
scenarios.noteZhHant: did 後面用原形；肯定句要用過去式。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Hello, I would like to make an appointment.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Is tomorrow morning okay?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Is there a time available today? I feel sick.
dialogue.zhHant: 今日仲有冇時間？我唔舒服。

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Yes, you can come at three.

scenarios.taskZhHant: 講你需要預約、簡單描述唔舒服，再確認日期時間。
scenarios.noteZhHant: 呢課係溝通練習；症狀、藥物及緊急求助字要另外學。

studyPlan.paceZhHant: 建議每次學 5–10 個字，按熟悉程度調整；唔設保證完成日數。遇到熟字亦要確認識唔識搭配同其他常用意思。

sequence.instructionsZhHant: 用 prerequisites 檢查人稱、問句、否定句、基本時態。唔熟嘅先學，唔需要一次背晒。
每次揀一個意思，讀同一意思嘅至少兩句例句，再將人物、地點或時間改成自己嘅情況。唔好將唔同意思嘅兩句當成已經學熟一個意思。
get / take / have 等每次只加一個意思；用 uses 入面嘅句型同例句，唔好一次背成段中文。
先做 MC，再做有中文嘅填充，之後做冇中文嘅填充；最後唔睇答案講自己嘅句子。
完成一段對話後改人物／地點／時間再做一次，並回答冇預先背過嘅追問。
翌日、幾日後、一星期後重試；將講唔到／聽唔明嘅字加入個人清單。

selfCheckZhHant: 睇到／聽到呢個字，能講出今次學嘅意思。
唔睇例句，用一個正確搭配講兩句自己嘅說話。
能聽明別人用呢個字問嘅簡單問題。
能完成相關情境任務，並回答一條追問。
studyPlan.progressRuleZhHant: MC／填充通過只代表識認或識填；四項自評都做到，先當呢個用法開始掌握。呢個係學習檢查，唔係認證或流利度分數。
studyPlan.nextStepZhHant: 完成後按生活需要補工作、交通、醫療等詞彙同片語；持續聽真實對話，唔以固定字數當成流利保證。
